english.title: Contravenes / fail to comply with requirement of Schedule 5 to Food Hygiene (Wales) Regulations 2006
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a producer who supplied meat in the manner described in paragraph 1 of Schedule 5 to the Food Hygiene (Wales) Regulations 2008, contravened or failed to comply with that schedule in that you failed

(A)_[to ensure that the meat you supplied bore a label or other marking clearly indicating the name and address of the farm where it was slaughtered]_
(B)_[to keep a record in adequate form to show the number of birds and the number of lagomorphs received into, and the amounts of fresh meat despatched from, your premises during each week]_
(C)_[to retain the record required under paragraph 2(2)(a) of that Schedule for a period of one year]_
(D)_[to make the record required under paragraph 2(2)(a) of that Schedule available to an authorised officer on request]_
(E)_[**(..SPECIFY COMBINATION OF ABOVE..)]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 17(2) and paragraph 3 of Schedule 5 to the Food Hygiene (Wales) Regulations 2006.

welsh.welshoffencetitle: Torri / methu cydymffurfio â gofyniad yn Atodlen 5 Rheoliadau Hylendid Bwyd (Cymru) 2006
welsh.welshstandardoffencewording:
Ar **(..SPECIFY DATE..) yn **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), a chithau'n gynhyrchydd yn cyflenwi cig yn y modd a ddisgrifir ym mharagraff 1 yn Atodlen 5 i Reoliadau Hylendid Bwyd (Cymru) 2008, bu i chi dorri neu fethu cydymffurfio â'r atodlen honno o ran eich bod wedi methu

(A)_[sicrhau bod y cig yr oeddech yn ei gyflenwi yn dwyn label neu farc arall a oedd yn dangos yn glir enw a chyfeiriad y fferm lle cafodd ei gigyddio]_
(B)_[cadw cofnod ar ffurf ddigonol i ddangos nifer yr adar a nifer y lagomorffiaid a dderbyniwyd i'ch mangre, a meintiau'r cig ffres a anfonwyd ohoni yn ystod pob wythnos]_
(C)_[cadw'r cofnod sy'n ofynnol dan baragraff 2(2)(a) yr Atodlen honno am gyfnod o flwyddyn]_
(D)_[trefnu bod y cofnod sy'n ofynnol dan baragraff 2(2)(a) yr Atodlen honno ar gael i swyddog awdurdodedig pan ofynnodd amdano]_
(E)_[**(..SPECIFY COMBINATION OF ABOVE..)]_
welsh.welshlegislation: Yn groes i reoliad 17(2) a pharagraff 3 yn Atodlen 5 Rheoliadau Hylendid Bwyd (Cymru) 2006.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
INDICTMENT: Two years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
No prosecution for an offence under these Regulations which is punishable under paragraph (2) of regulation 17 may be begun after the expiry of (a) three years from the commission of the offence; or (b) one year from its discovery by the prosecutor, whichever is the earlier.

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
